baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to taste, the deictic 'this', and the past habit of hastening.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oral tasting expands into suffered first-person knowledge: a formerly verbal challenge becomes present bodily evidence, and 'this' collapses the demanded future into an encounter now at hand.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting by the mouth supplies the bodily mode in which the threatened object becomes undeniable.
Experiencing and testing extends taste from flavor into suffered first-person knowledge.
Calamity, ordeal, and punishment supply the object that tasting makes experiential.
A state located in past time makes hastening a settled prior habit whose result is now present.
Seeking something before its time supplies the temporal provocation now answered.

changed_reading.before: A threat tells impatient people that punishment has arrived.
changed_reading.after: The threat compels a conversion from verbal demand to bodily proof: the future they solicited is now the demonstrable 'this' they must experience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of tasting with 'your fitna'.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fitna can be an assay of metal or person and can also be burning; tasting makes the assay reflexively knowable. The possessive permits the fire to disclose the quality of those undergoing it, not merely to inflict external pain.

activation_trace.role: Experiential testing makes the assay something known by undergoing it.
Testing metal and people supplies the discriminating assay mechanism.
Burning and fire-darkening provide the material process by which the assay reveals and alters.

changed_reading.before: Their fitna is simply a punishment assigned to them.
changed_reading.after: Their fitna is also a furnace-like disclosure: they must experience the process that exposes what they are.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive in 'your fitna' joined to their own act of hastening.
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive can mark causal ownership as well as allocation. Their deviation from the right course and their demand for premature fulfillment return as the very experience they are ordered to taste.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from the right course supplies a fitna generated through misorientation, not only an externally imposed ordeal.
Suffered experience turns their prior misorientation into its personally known consequence.
Their own premature solicitation supplies the action that causally returns upon them.

changed_reading.before: They receive an ordeal that belongs to them only as an assigned penalty.
changed_reading.after: They taste a fitna that is 'theirs' because their deflection and premature demand helped constitute the experience now returned to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from 'you used to' to the present deictic 'this' under the command to taste.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of tasting describes becoming a new condition after separation from an earlier one. Coupled with past being and premature seeking, the command marks a temporal state-change: habitual demand has crossed into the condition demanded.

activation_trace.role: Becoming a condition after departure supplies the transition from prior stance into present ordeal.
Being in a past time supplies the old state from which the command effects transition.
Advancing an event before its time supplies the selected destination of the transition.
Ordeal and affliction name the new condition into which the former habit resolves.

changed_reading.before: Taste means only to suffer something now.
changed_reading.after: Taste marks entry into a new state: what existed as habitual anticipation has become the ordeal's present mode of being.

context_deltas.mechanism: Release, load-bearing, smooth transit, and apportionment form an ordered delivery sequence. Against that sequence, hastening is an attempt to collapse stages; 'this' is the allocated load after the process reaches its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Premature solicitation anchors the focus as resistance to an ordered time of arrival.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the release stage of the inferred delivery process.
Lifting an outward load supplies transport after release.
A heavy burden gives the transported object consequential weight.
Flowing movement supplies transit through the sequence.
Light, compliant motion makes the transit unobstructed rather than hurried.
Apportioning a share supplies the terminal allocation to its proper recipient.
A sign or appointment supplies ordered timing for the distributed affair.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 presents four coordinated stages in a marked sequence before the promise is asserted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, burden, flow, ease, allocation, and appointment; I connect them as a delivery pipeline ending in 51:14. A live alternative is that the sequence only swears to certainty and does not model delivery.

changed_reading.before: They wanted a delayed punishment to happen sooner.
changed_reading.after: They demanded that an ordered delivery bypass its stages; the command announces that the apportioned burden has completed its route to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Threatened promise becomes verified performance, then reckoning or debt, then fixed occurrence. Tasting is not an arbitrary eruption but settlement of what was announced and demanded.

activation_trace.role: Experiential knowledge supplies the final verification that the announced matter has been settled.
A threatening promise supplies the announced liability behind the focus.
Fulfilling promise in action converts announcement into performed truth.
Debt supplies a legal-accounting image for an obligation now collected.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the promise's transition into irreversible occurrence.

structural_cues: 51:5-6 moves from what is promised, to its truth, to reckoning, to occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, enacted truth, debt or reckoning, and fixed occurrence; I infer a settlement chain culminating in taste. The live alternative keeps din strictly as judgment and drops the debt metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The command is a sudden retaliatory taunt.
changed_reading.after: The command is experiential receipt of a matured liability: the threatened promise has become fixed and is now collected.

context_deltas.mechanism: A well-made order is followed by divergent doctrines and then turning away from the proper direction. This activates 'your fitna' as a cognitive topology they inhabited: fractured speech repeatedly inverted their orientation until the distortion became an experienced world.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from the right course anchors fitna as misorientation that can become self-maintaining.
Well-wrought coherence supplies the ordered reality against which their discourse is measured.
Speech as doctrine or belief makes the differing saying an inhabited orientation, not mere noise.
Each party taking a path unlike another supplies the fragmentation of orientation.
Turning a thing away from its direction supplies the recurrent inversion that links discourse to fitna.

structural_cues: 51:7-9 contrasts a coherent woven order with differing speech and repeats the passive turning verb at both ends of 51:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coherence, doctrinal speech, divergent paths, and doubled inversion; I infer a causal loop in which discourse stabilizes misorientation. Alternatively, the context may only diagnose disagreement without making it productive of the ordeal.

changed_reading.before: Their fitna is an external event that happens to mistaken speakers.
changed_reading.after: Their fitna also names the experiential world produced by repeatedly inverted speech; tasting exposes the reality their discourse had turned away from.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immersion and heedlessness issue in the question 'when?', which names the day of reckoning immediately before the focus. The past hastening is thus recoverable as a performed utterance: their question solicits the very day whose experience answers it.

activation_trace.role: Requesting an event before its time anchors the preceding question as the focus's act of haste.
An engulfing cover of falsehood, ignorance, and distraction supplies the cognitive medium from which the question arises.
Heedlessness of heart makes the timing question resistant rather than informational.
Questioning and requesting provide the speech act through which haste is performed.
A day's severe event supplies the concrete time-object requested.
Reckoning and recompense identify what the requested day will execute.

structural_cues: 51:10 labels the speakers as conjecturers without a branch inventory, and 51:12 immediately voices their timing question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immersion, heedlessness, a question about when, and the day of reckoning; I infer that the question is a taunting request and therefore the act denoted by hastening. It could instead be a literal request for information.

changed_reading.before: Hastening is an unspecified earlier attitude.
changed_reading.after: Hastening is staged in the local scene as their own 'when?' question; the imperative is the answer that turns requested information into experienced event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah locates them over fire and uses the same fitna root verbally. The focus nominalizes that active burning or assay as 'your fitna', while tasting makes its material process bodily known.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting gives the already active fire-process a second bodily register.
Assaying metal or people keeps discrimination active within the fire scene.
Kindled fire supplies the explicit material environment for the focus's fitna.
Burning and fire-darkening sharpen the verbal cognate into an active thermal process.

structural_cues: 51:13 and 51:14 place verbal and nominal forms of the same root across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit fire plus the verbal cognate; I infer that the noun in 51:14 resumes and sharpens that process. A live alternative keeps fitna broader as ordeal or assay rather than reducing it to flame.

changed_reading.before: Fitna is a broad ordeal that might include punishment.
changed_reading.after: Fitna resumes the process already occurring over fire: they are commanded to taste the burning assay that is exposing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to receive an owned ordeal is immediately answered by protected people amid gardens and springs actively taking what was given. The juxtaposition creates two intake systems: compulsory tasting of a self-associated fitna versus receptive taking of a cultivated gift.

activation_trace.role: Oral intake anchors the condemned side of the reception contrast.
Their ordeal supplies the adverse object forcibly received.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the prior posture behind the contrasting reception.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies the cultivated receiving environment opposite exposed fire.
A flowing water source supplies a drinkable counter-image to tasting the ordeal.
Taking and possessing supplies the voluntary receptive action opposed to compulsory tasting.
Giving supplies the beneficent source and direction of the contrasting object.
Doing good supplies the antecedent practice that makes gifted reception fitting.

structural_cues: The ayah boundary directly juxtaposes 'taste your' in 51:14 with 'taking what their Lord gave them' in 51:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two acts of intake, adverse versus beneficent objects, and prior self-protection or good action; I infer an antithetical reception system. Alternatively, the scenes may contrast outcomes without making tasting an anti-gift.

changed_reading.before: Taste is only a conventional punishment command.
changed_reading.after: Taste is an anti-reception: they compulsorily take in the ordeal associated with them, opposite those who freely receive a cultivated gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated past-state constructions align two histories. The focus remembers habitual haste; the following scene remembers doing good, little sleep, seeking protection from fault, and maintaining a fixed due. Present reception is thus the ripened form of repeated temporal practice.

activation_trace.role: Past being makes haste an enduring behavioral history rather than a single utterance.
Habitual premature demand supplies one temporal practice whose result has matured.
A corresponding past state introduces the alternative history of doing good.
Repeated past being extends that alternative history into disciplined night practice.
Smallness supplies measured restraint rather than impatient temporal compression.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer supplies a patient response to liability.
A fixed obligatory due supplies timely discharge rather than demand for premature receipt.

structural_cues: The past-state construction in 51:14 recurs in 51:16 and 51:17, introducing opposed habitual profiles.
51:17 also contains sleep without branch inventory; its quantified scarcity remains only a structural support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated past-state grammar and opposed habits; I infer that those histories causally ripen into the two present receptions. A live alternative treats the repetition as ordinary narration without a designed symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The phrase 'you used to hasten' merely recalls a past taunt.
changed_reading.after: The phrase records a cultivated temporal character: repeated haste ripens into forced ordeal just as restrained, reparative practice ripens into protected reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs, self-inspection, seeing, promise, sworn truth, and ordinary speech form a ladder of available evidence. Tasting is the terminal sensory channel: when visual and verbal signs did not produce certainty, the promised truth becomes invasive bodily knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge acquired by direct experience supplies the final, unavoidable evidentiary mode.
A manifest sign supplies evidence that was available before the compelled experience.
Stable knowledge without doubt names the epistemic result signs could have produced.
The self as the very thing supplies an internal field of evidence, making ignorance less excusable.
Insight of the heart supplies the refused interpretive capacity between visible sign and certainty.
Threatening promise supplies verbal foreknowledge of the object later tasted.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the status of the promise independently of their reception.
Speech as an evident sign supplies the final analogy for certainty before evidence becomes bodily.

structural_cues: 51:20-23 moves through earth, self, sky, promise, oath, and the addressees' own speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive visual, inward, promissory, and speech-based warrants; I infer an evidentiary escalation culminating retrospectively in taste. Alternatively, these signs console believers rather than explain why the condemned must taste.

changed_reading.before: Taste is a sensory idiom for pain.
changed_reading.after: Taste is coerced certainty: ignored signs and speech are replaced by first-person bodily verification of the promised truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The gestational analogy is surprising because it activates a form-distant branch of hastening. It remains anchored in the focus's request-before-time construction and is supported by nearby hidden carrying and an appointed promise. Render it only as a material analogy for timing, not as a lexical claim that the punishment is a birth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request to hasten, especially its branch of delivery before a complete term.

activation_trace.role: Delivery before the completed term supplies the outlier's precise image of premature fulfillment.
Hidden pregnancy or fruit supplies a carried process whose result requires maturation.
A promise fixed to an appointed time supplies the term they try to outrun.

changed_reading.before: They merely ask for the event too soon.
changed_reading.after: They demand delivery before its term; the focus confronts them with the matured issue of what had been carried toward them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The culinary-economic reading is odd because it crosses punishment, food, allocation, and provision. It remains anchored in literal tasting and the branch where life has bitter and sweet conditions, with nearby apportionment and allotted provision. Render it as an exploratory anti-provision model, not as a denial of fire or ordeal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Literal tasting of 'your fitna' and fitna's two bitter-sweet conditions.

activation_trace.role: Oral tasting supplies the consumption frame for an adverse allotment.
Life in two bitter and sweet conditions supplies the reversal from enjoyed portion to bitter course.
Apportioning shares supplies the idea that the tasted ordeal is their assigned portion.
Allotted provision supplies the positive counterpart against which the ordeal reads as anti-provision.

changed_reading.before: The ordeal is only an inflicted environment.
changed_reading.after: The ordeal can be carried as their allotted bitter portion: an anti-provision they must consume after misreading life's two conditions.

strongest_changes: The verbal fitna over explicit fire in 51:13 sharpens the focus from generic ordeal into a burning assay without exhausting the broader sense.
The ordered sequence and promise language in 51:1-6 recast haste as an attempt to collapse delivery stages and tasting as settlement of a matured liability.
The reception contrast and repeated past-state grammar in 51:15-19 make prior habits ripen into opposed forms of present intake.
The signs and speech sequence in 51:20-23 turns tasting into coerced sensory certainty after mediated evidence was refused.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings remain live together: bodily verification, furnace assay, return of self-owned deviation, temporal state-conversion, anti-gift, and the contained images of premature delivery and allotted anti-provision.
remaining_uncertainties: The possessive may mark an ordeal allotted to them, an ordeal produced by them, or both.
The explicit fire strongly sharpens fitna but may not reduce its assay, deviation, and broader ordeal senses to flame alone.
The opening transport sequence may attest certainty rather than encode a delivery mechanism.
The gestational and anti-provision readings depend on cross-domain structural analogy and should remain exploratory.
